artifacts.name: environment-setup
artifacts.title: Set up your environment
artifacts.description: A guided install of Python, Robot Framework and a library that matches what you actually want to test. Asks for your operating system, your goal and your background first, then gives commands for that setup instead of a generic list.

artifacts.name: browser-test
artifacts.title: Write your first browser test
artifacts.description: Walks you to a well-structured Browser-library test — modern keywords, a real Settings section, and an explanation of every line. Carries the keyword documentation with it, so the assistant works from real signatures rather than guesses.
